title: Requirement Detail (RD)
description: One YAML file per RD under rd/. content_hash covers ONLY statement + ac[] + nfr_refs (plan §4.2).

profile.description: RD-level override of the module/project profile (config/gates.yaml). Optional — absent means "inherit the effective module/project profile". May only lower ceremony relative to that inherited value, never raise it (one_way_ratchet in gates.yaml). Set by ba/planner at /cz:rd drafting time per the complexity heuristic in skills/rd-decomposition/SKILL.md.

split_from.description: If this RD was produced by a split, the parent RD id it was split from. Null/absent for RDs that are not split products.

split_depth.description: 0 for an RD not produced by a split; parent's split_depth + 1 for a split product. Used by skills/rd-decomposition/SKILL.md's fan-out/depth cap. Absent is treated as 0.

summary.description: One-line, human-scannable gloss of the statement — shown as the board's RD-table Summary column. Optional but expected on every RD from /cz:rd onward; not covered by content_hash.

priority.description: Operational metadata, not covered by content_hash (docs/TRACEABILITY.md). Optional — absent/omitted is treated as "medium" by hooks/project-state.sh's board projection.

red_skipped.description: Permanent once true. Only ever true under profile: light AND layer: 1.

pending_verification.description: True when this RD's build loop had to move forward without completing a genuine red-green cycle, for a documented reason outside the loop's control (e.g. blocked on external tooling/hardware/a dependency not yet available) — distinct from red_skipped, which is the light-profile/layer-1 policy skip. Not clearable by simply omitting the field: hooks/guard-state-transition.sh denies any transition to accepted while this is true, so the deferred proof stays visible until someone actually runs it and flips this back to false. Optional; absent is treated as false.

pending_verification_reason.description: Required whenever pending_verification is true (see the allOf conditional below). Free text: what's blocked and why red-green could not run, e.g. 'blocked on external hardware rig, ETA next sprint'.

notes.description: Free-text change-log — why this version changed (which AC edit, which DoR-rule failure, a content_hash recompute/no-recompute rationale, a split/supersession pointer to the successor RD(s)). Not covered by content_hash. Optional on version 1; hooks/warn-rd-changelog.sh logs an advisory (non-blocking) when version >= 2 and this is empty/absent — see docs/TRACEABILITY.md.

smoke_log.description: Path to evidence/RD-<id>/smoke-vN.log written by cz-build.md's smoke-check step, when config/gates.yaml defines smoke_check.command. Null/absent when no smoke_check is configured for the project.

allOf.description: Six-way RD validity rule (plan §4.1): AC count 1-3, sizing bounds, one module, no cross-module AC — enforced in full by /cz:rd, this schema only checks the structurally-representable parts.
A deferred red-green proof must always be explained — pending_verification:true with no reason is exactly the silent-loss failure mode this field exists to prevent.
